clips.title: The story
paras: On Tarren Mill's bounty board, Lady Sylvanas's decree condemns every Syndicate member to death. The Forsaken seek to clear the brigands from Durnholde Keep's ruins before they threaten Horde operations in the foothills.

The Syndicate's sudden arrival southeast of Tarren Mill has drawn the Forsaken's attention. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and her commanders see the Syndicate as an active pestilence, not displaced nobles to bargain with. The bounty orders immediate death. Any prisoners brought in will be executed without trial.

Durnholde Keep, once an infamous internment fortress, now lies shattered and lawless. Syndicate Rogues and Watchmen have taken its crumbling ramparts and towers as an operations hub. High Executor Darthalia needs the armed bandits driven from the ruins to secure the road and protect Tarren Mill's southeastern approach.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: By the authority of Lady Sylvanas, all members of the organization known as the Syndicate are wanted dead. Those brought into custody or taken prisoner will be summarily executed. They are currently known to be amassing in the ruins of Durnholde Keep, to the southeast of Tarren Mill.
A handsome reward is offered to all who bring proof of their deeds to High Executor Darthalia.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have nothing better to do than stand here before me, adventurer? As High Executor, I have more pressing matters than to stare at your rotting visage.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent, adventurer. At this rate, the Syndicate pest will be rid from the land in no time.
